Alibaba\'s realtime transcription model with high quality, fast recognition speed, and good accuracy, suitable for general Chinese and English scenarios. The stream-input version has lower latency and faster recognition speed.

Alibaba\'s realtime transcription model with high quality, fast recognition speed, and good accuracy, suitable for general Chinese and English scenarios. The non-stream-input version provides higher recognition accuracy with more complete semantics and text structure.
OpenAI\'s realtime streaming transcription model for Realtime sessions. Best for low-latency captions and live dictation.

OpenAI\'s transcription model with high quality and strong recognition, especially effective for English, multilingual international scenarios, accented English, and international languages. The non-stream-input version provides higher recognition accuracy with more complete semantics and text structure.

OpenAI\'s lightweight transcription model that inherits the strengths of GPT-4o Transcribe while offering lower cost and lower latency, suitable for frequent continuous use. The non-stream-input version provides higher recognition accuracy with more complete semantics and text structure.

ByteDance\'s Doubao transcription model with higher accuracy in vertical domains, better recognition in complex scenarios, context support, and more features. The stream-input version has lower latency and faster recognition speed, supporting Chinese and English only.

ByteDance\'s Doubao transcription model with higher accuracy in vertical domains, better recognition in complex scenarios, context support, and more features. The non-stream-input version provides higher recognition accuracy with more complete semantics and text structure.

ByteDance\'s Doubao transcription model that inherits the strengths of Doubao Seed ASR 2.0 (non-stream input) while offering lower latency and faster transcription speed. The non-stream-input version provides higher recognition accuracy with more complete semantics and text structure.
